title: Industrial Genesis
description:
This modpack is a hardcore technology-focused modpack
本整合包是一个硬核的科技整合包
body:
This package contains most of the industrial processes, which are basically in line with **reality**, and the process is **longer**, and some **leisure** content _will be added_ in the future to make the process less boring

The process of this package ranges from the Stone Age to the Steam Age ([Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)) to the Electric Age ([Create: Power Grid](https://modrinth.com/mod/power-grid)+[GTM](https://modrinth.com/mod/gregtechceu-modern))

Its content is not yet perfect,and I will add the following content later:

1. The real power system (RPM to a certain extent, the component will be damaged)✅
2. Real veins ✅❎
3. Realistic melting system (with [Create: Metallurgy](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-metallurgy) and [Ceramics](https://modrinth.com/mod/ceramics)) ❎
4. The real GTM recipe ❎
5. ……

❗️I'm sorry, my computer is broken, so I can't update temporarily


这个整合包包含了大部分工业流程，基本上与**现实**相符，且流程**很长**，未来将添加一些**休闲**内容以使流程不那么无聊

本整合包的流程从石器时代再到蒸汽时代([机械动力](https://modrinth.com/mod/create))，电气时代([机械动力：交错电网](https://modrinth.com/mod/power-grid)+[GTM](https://modrinth.com/mod/gregtechceu-modern))

它的内容还不太完善，我之后将会添加以下内容：


1. 真实的应力系统（RPM到一定程度，元件会损坏）✅
2. 真实的矿脉 ✅❎
3. 真实的熔炼系统（利用[机械动力：冶金学](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-metallurgy)和[陶瓷器](https://modrinth.com/mod/ceramics)） ❎
4. 真实的GTM配方❎
5. ……
